chapter1.mapping: u = (world_Y - min_y) * px_per_uu ; v = (max_x - world_X) * px_per_uu
chapter1.z_quantisation: code = 1 + round((Z - z_min) / (z_max - z_min) * 4094) ; 0 = no surface
chapter1.reach_flag: bit 12 of the height code = the surface is reachable
